basic_details.job_title: Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.application_mode: Online (OAP) and Offline through Proper Channel

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for direct recruitment is 35 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | ps to chairman: (i) A Degree from a recognized University.(ii) Proficiency in stenography and typewriting with a speed of 120/40 w.p.m. respectively.(iii) Knowledge of Computer Application.(iv) Eight years experience as Stenographer / PA in an industrial / commercial / Govt. Undertaking.

salary_details.ps to chairman: Rs. 20600-46500 / Rs. 10750-16750 (Pre-revised scales) or Rs. 50000-160000 (Revised scales)
salary_details.details: The post is filled on an Absorption / Deputation basis under the terms and conditions prescribed by the Central Government.

selection_process: The selection process for the PS to Chairman post is carried out through absorption / deputation
how_to_apply: Access the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways.
Submit the online application for the PS to Chairman post.
Take a printout of the submitted online application.
Gather copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and a self-attested passport-size photograph.
Obtain a copy of the undertaking not to withdraw if selected.
Ensure the application is forwarded through the proper channel along with ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance, verification of university certificates, and NOC.
Send the complete documents to SECRETARY, CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY, RAJAJI SALAI, CHENNAI – 600 001 on or before 11 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date or without proper channel, ACRs/APARs, or enclosures will not be considered. The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of receipt of applications, i.e., 11 November 2026. Officers must ensure the submission of annual immovable property returns under Rule 18 of CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964. Absorption or deputation will be governed by terms and conditions prescribed by the Central Government.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Chennai Port Authority
content_sections.text: Access the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways. Submit the online application for the PS to Chairman post. Take a printout of the submitted online application. Gather copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and a self-attested passport-size photograph. Obtain a copy of the undertaking not to withdraw if selected. Ensure the application is forwarded through the proper channel along with ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance, verification of university certificates, and NOC. Send the complete documents to SECRETARY, CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY, RAJAJI SALAI, CHENNAI – 600 001 on or before 11 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Copies of educational qualifications and experience Undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw if selected Self-attested Passport Size Photo Photocopy of ACRs / APARs of the applicant for the last 5 years duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Head of Department Willingness of the candidate for joining the post in case of selection No Objection Certificate of respective Port Authority Vigilance / Administrative Clearance certificate Certificate confirming the veracity of University Certificates Certificate if ACR / APAR for a particular period is not available Details of major/minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years, if any Complete service details of the applicant at Annexure-4

content_sections.heading: Chennai Port Authority Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date or without proper channel, ACRs/APARs, or enclosures will not be considered. The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of receipt of applications, i.e., 11 November 2026. Officers must ensure the submission of annual immovable property returns under Rule 18 of CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964. Absorption or deputation will be governed by terms and conditions prescribed by the Central Government.

faq.question: Q1. What is Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by Chennai Port Authority to fill 1 vacancy for the PS to Chairman post on an absorption or deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the PS to Chairman post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application through the proper channel is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required for Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree from a recognized University, proficiency in stenography and typewriting (120/40 w.p.m.), knowledge of computer applications, and eight years of experience as a Stenographer/PA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman direct recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for direct recruitment is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Chennai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply online through the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways OAP portal and send the printed application through the proper channel to the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman?
faq.answer: The selection is made by absorption or deputation, failing which by direct recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or pay scale for Chennai Port Authority PS to Chairman?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 20600-46500 / Rs. 10750-16750 (Pre-revised) or Rs. 50000-160000 (Revised scales).

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to SECRETARY, CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY, RAJAJI SALAI, CHENNAI – 600 001.
